name: community-navigator-form
description: Community Navigator remote intake form (Pages static build artifact; relay blueprint step 6, ADR-005 D2/D3/D8). Attendee-facing, template-driven, seals submissions in-browser to the facilitator public key with libsodium crypto_box_seal. Separate build from app/; shares no runtime code with it. libsodium-wrappers is the ONLY runtime dependency.
